"HONEY EMPIRE – COMPLETE ROBLOX SIMULATOR GAME

Create a polished, addictive Roblox-style incremental simulator called HONEY EMPIRE.

The game revolves around collecting bees, producing honey, filling collectible jars, purchasing upgrades, unlocking new worlds and building the ultimate honey empire.

The game should feel like a high-quality Roblox simulator with satisfying animations, rewarding progression, colorful environments and a well-designed economy.

1. CORE GAMEPLAY LOOP

The main gameplay loop is:

Collect pollen → Bees produce honey → Fill honey jars → Sell jars → Earn coins → Purchase upgrades → Unlock better bees → Unlock new worlds → Rebirth.

Make the gameplay satisfying and rewarding at every stage.

2. BEE SYSTEM

Create a collection system with multiple bee rarities:

- Common
- Uncommon
- Rare
- Epic
- Legendary
- Mythical
- Divine
- Secret

Every bee must have unique:

- Appearance and animations.
- Honey production speed.
- Pollen collection speed.
- Carrying capacity.
- Movement speed.
- Special abilities.

Bees should automatically fly between flowers and beehives.

Add an egg hatching system with different egg types, rarity probabilities and exclusive bees for each world.

Add a bee fusion system where players can combine 3 identical bees to create a stronger version.

3. HONEY PRODUCTION

Create an automated honey production system.

Bees collect pollen from flowers and return to their hive to convert pollen into honey.

Different flowers produce different types of honey.

Display real-time honey production statistics.

Allow players to upgrade production speed, pollen capacity, bee efficiency and honey multipliers.

4. HONEY JAR SYSTEM – IMPORTANT

This must be one of the most visually satisfying mechanics in the entire game.

Players have collectible honey jars with different capacities, designs and special bonuses.

When a jar fills up:

1. Display a beautiful jar-filling animation.
2. Show golden honey physically pouring into the jar.
3. The honey level must visibly rise inside the transparent jar.
4. Add realistic dripping effects, bubbles and reflections.
5. Play satisfying pouring sound effects.
6. When full, close the jar with a lid.
7. Make the jar glow briefly.
8. Display the amount of honey collected.
9. Allow the player to sell the jar and receive rewards.

The honey pouring animation must be smooth and visually appealing.

Do not replace this mechanic with a simple progress bar.

5. UPGRADE TREE

Create a large interactive upgrade tree with four separate branches:

HONEY PRODUCTION

- Honey per second.
- Honey multipliers.
- Pollen conversion efficiency.
- Critical production chance.

BEE EFFICIENCY

- Bee flying speed.
- Pollen collection speed.
- Maximum bee capacity.
- Number of active bees.

JAR TECHNOLOGY

- Jar capacity.
- Filling speed.
- Multiple active jars.
- Selling price bonuses.

ROYAL RESEARCH

- Better egg luck.
- Rare bee probabilities.
- Permanent multipliers.
- Rebirth bonuses.

Use interconnected nodes, unlock requirements, upgrade levels, prices and visually distinct purchased/unlocked/locked states.

6. WORLDS

Create five unique explorable worlds:

1. STARTER MEADOW – beginner flowers, worker bees and basic honey.
2. DESERT ISLAND – cactus flowers, desert bees and golden sand jars.
3. FROZEN KINGDOM – ice bees, frozen honey and crystal jars.
4. ENCHANTED FOREST – magical flowers, fairy bees and emerald jars.
5. COSMIC GALAXY – celestial bees, stardust honey and cosmic jars.

Every world must have unique environmental assets, music, flowers, bees, eggs, jars and exclusive upgrades.

Require players to reach specific honey and progression milestones before unlocking new worlds.

7. REBIRTH SYSTEM

Allow players to reset their normal progression in exchange for permanent rewards.

Create:

- Rebirth tokens.
- Permanent honey multipliers.
- Exclusive royal bees.
- Rebirth-only upgrades.
- Special cosmetics.
- Rebirth milestones.

Add a separate Royal Rebirth Upgrade Tree. (App)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
